title: Stage 2 material spike: reference | ours, at half size (demo library; ours is the real page, baked by the kiln)
notes: ok: one material everywhere: smoky body, hot top line, coral roll along bottom edges, light rising low in the glass
ok: the colour follows the cover: rose from Silver Current, violet from Cold Winters, silver for covers with little colour
ok: text is upright DOM text in Montserrat; spacing and alignment are exact (the references wobble)
part: the ribbon is about 20% shorter than the reference's, on purpose, so more rows show; its bulb, low waist, rising lip, pod and tail are all there
part: the seek line runs beside the cover and under the bowls, above the lower roll, rather than dipping under the cover (it reads better off the bright roll)
part: the room's wisps are calmer than the reference's swirls
no: the reference's big rounded window slab: a real Windows 11 window has 8 px corners, so the rim hugs those
no: the sidebar's edge doesn't yet flow into the ribbon's bulb as one piece; it melts away behind it instead
no: caption buttons are Windows' own (they don't show in a page capture)
